title: Fix-first: classify the five unclassified state verbs in the projection-race coverage gate
action: PRE-EXISTING RED, not caused by validation-diet: it reproduces on baseline commit 33d58a7e. The suite's coverage check (f) enumerates the CLI manifest's state verbs and refuses any it cannot classify. Five are unclassified: state.route, state.feature-verify.record, state.feature-verify.show, state.workflows.list, state.workflows.close -- added by commits 0e0fb5fe (main-verifies) and 99b989bf (workflow-lifecycle) without the suite being extended. Derive the correct bucket for EACH verb yourself by reading what it actually does in packages/bee/bee.mjs: a verb that writes .bee/state.json belongs in STATE_WRITING_VERBS and must get a probe like its siblings; a verb that only reads, or writes somewhere else entirely, belongs in NON_PROJECTION_VERBS. Do NOT dump all five into NON_PROJECTION_VERBS to make the red go away -- that is exactly the escape hatch the check exists to close ('a new writer of .bee/state.json could be escaping this suite'). state.feature-verify.record and state.route in particular do write state; check them carefully. Capture the failing run as your before-evidence; do not author a probe script.

truths: Every verb placed in STATE_WRITING_VERBS is actually probed by the suite, not just listed
No verb that writes .bee/state.json is parked in NON_PROJECTION_VERBS
key_links: each classification matches the verb's real behavior in packages/bee/bee.mjs
prohibitions: No weakening or skipping of coverage check (f)

trace.outcome: Classified 5 state verbs in test_state_projection_race.mjs: state.route and state.feature-verify.record write .bee/state.json/lane files via withMutationLock (STATE_WRITING_VERBS + new held-lock probes); state.feature-verify.show, state.workflows.list, state.workflows.close read or write only the workflow-store record, not the projection (NON_PROJECTION_VERBS). Suite now exits 0.
